description_en: Invoke ListCases to obtain the execution details list of the outbound contact list for the predictive dialing Activity corresponding to the specified ID under the specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListCases获取指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动的外呼名单执行详情列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-cases --instance-id ccc-test --campaign-id 6badb397-a8b5-40b6-21019d382a09 --phone-number '无' --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --state Pending --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCases

parameters.description_en: Filters by phone number. Fuzzy Matching is not supported. This parameter is not Required and defaults to empty.
parameters.description_zh: 按电话号码过滤，不支持模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空。
parameters.help_en: Filters by phone number. Fuzzy Matching is not supported. This parameter is not Required and defaults to empty

parameters.description_en: The paging ordinal number, ranging from 1 to 100.
parameters.help_en: The paging ordinal number, ranging from 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en:
Pending (to be dialed)
Executing (dialing in progress)
Connected (contact succeeded)
Failed (contact failed)
Aborted (call stopped or canceled)
Forbidden (call prohibited by rule, such as blacklist)
parameters.description_zh:

Aborted（止呼, 取消呼叫）  
Forbidden（规则禁止呼叫，比如黑名单）
